# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities through GitHub's **Private vulnerability reporting** feature for this repository. Do not open a public issue, discussion, pull request, or other public disclosure for an unpatched security finding.

Include enough information to reproduce and assess the issue, such as the affected component, observed behavior, reproduction steps, impact, and any relevant logs or proof-of-concept details. Do not include real credentials, secrets, personal data, or destructive payloads.

## Coordinated disclosure

Please keep vulnerability details private until a fix or mitigation is available and coordinated disclosure is appropriate. Good-faith research that avoids privacy violations, service disruption, data destruction, persistence, or access beyond what is necessary to demonstrate the issue is encouraged.

## Scope

Security reports concerning repository code, GitHub Actions workflows, dependency or supply-chain risks, authentication or authorization, secrets exposure, deployment configuration, or production-facing behavior are in scope when they affect this repository.

## Supported versions

The current production/default branch is the supported security baseline unless a release or maintenance policy in this repository states otherwise.
